integrity: Symbolic 2-adic lower-bound argument, 37-row complete divisor-factorization certificate, and exhaustive trial-factorization check of every smaller four-prime-support integer; no probabilistic primality methods.
scientific_limitations: Determines the least integer with exactly four distinct prime divisors satisfying the divisor-totient equation and the complete first squarefree four-prime totient fiber. Does not classify the full unbounded four-prime-support solution set or assert infinitude.
title: The first four-prime-support layer of \(\tau(n^2)=\tau(\varphi(n))\)
